name: io.github.haidrau/sentinel-mcp-server
description:
⚠️ Real-time Shopee competitor price monitoring via MCP. Does NOT work standalone — requires browser extension + monitored products + MCP Key.

T-0 (same-day, 3× daily) price data covering Shopee SG/MY/TH/VN/ID/PH. Push notifications via Feishu/DingTalk/Telegram. 8 MCP tools for querying, monitoring, and analyzing competitor price movements.

environmentVariables.name: SENTINEL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Sentinel MCP Key. Get it from the browser extension settings page (NOT from the website login). See: https://priceminder.online/docs/quick-start

environmentVariables.name: SENTINEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Internal API key for backend communication

prompts.name: store-level-watch
prompts.description: Monitor all products from a specific Shopee store and alert on price drops over 5%

prompts.name: flash-sale-alert
prompts.description: Check every 4 hours during campaign period for price changes over 3%

prompts.name: price-drop-intelligence
prompts.description: Deep dive into recent price drops and highlight the biggest movers
